title: Über Schwingungen in Raumgittern
doi_note: Physikalische Zeitschrift 13, 297-309 (1912), title as printed in Born bibliographies and in independent citing records; English: 'On vibrations in space lattices'. There is no publisher record for the 1912 volume and no digitised copy of it was found while preparing this list, so the page range still rests on the citing records only; the alternative is to cite Born and Huang (1954), see related_books_2026-11-01.csv
availability: not held - the 1912 note itself is still not available in any form; on 2026-11-01 the related book Born and Huang (1954) arrived and was read (printed pp. 55-57 and p. 79): its §5 credits the 1912 note by name and prints the chain dispersion whose equal-mass limit is the manuscript's formula, so CR181 now needs only a direct quotation of the 1912 note, not the derivation
